region_or_platform_notes: The 2026-09-10 changelog says this model has been retired and the old name is temporarily routed to V4.1 Flash. The pricing page says the name is still accepted, the model has been retired, and requests are served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 at the Flash price. No shutdown day is printed. The pages say to use deepseek-flash.

sources.label: DeepSeek models and pricing
sources.excerpt: The legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted, but the corresponding models have been retired, their requests are served by the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 model and billed at the Flash price.

sources.label: DeepSeek API changelog
sources.excerpt: The previous-generation models V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp have been retired; for compatibility, the model names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are temporarily routed to V4.1 Flash.
